{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Strategic

|descr= Unregister texture(s) to be displayed over CfgORBAT group.

|s1= [path, displayID] call [[BIS_fnc_ORBATRemoveGroupOverlay]]

|p1= path: [[Config]] - path to {{hl|CfgORBAT}} group config

|p2= displayID: [[Number]] - overlay ID returned by [[BIS_fnc_ORBATAddGroupOverlay]]

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if overlay entry was removed

|x1= <sqf>[configFile >> "CfgORBAT" >> "BIS" >> "O_Brigade", 4] call BIS_fnc_ORBATRemoveGroupOverlay;</sqf>

|seealso= [[ORBAT Viewer]] [[BIS_fnc_ORBATAddGroupOverlay]] [[BIS_fnc_ORBATAnimate]] [[BIS_fnc_ORBATConfigPreview]] [[BIS_fnc_ORBATGetGroupParams]] [[BIS_fnc_ORBATOpen]] [[BIS_fnc_ORBATSetGroupFade]] [[BIS_fnc_ORBATSetGroupParams]] [[BIS_fnc_ORBATTooltip]]
